plan.notes: UAF 2026-2027 catalog, B.S. Mathematics, Mathematics concentration (Math for Secondary Education and Statistics concentrations also published). GER recorded at 36 of 36-40; the 8-credit physics sequence satisfies both the B.S. natural science requirement and the concentration and is counted once under the concentration (block layout follows the catalog's published requirement blocks). General electives recorded at 28 of the 23-29 range to reconcile the 120 minimum. C- or better required in each course; 12 credits of 300+ MATH must be taken in residence in Fairbanks. No official semester sequence published for this program.

courses.title: General Education Requirements (36-40 credits)
courses.choice_note: Complete UAF general education requirements (36-40 credits, recorded at 36), which must include MATH F251X Calculus I.

courses.title: MATH F252X Calculus II
courses.choice_note: Required as part of the B.S. degree requirements.

courses.title: Natural science sequence (8 credits)
courses.choice_note: B.S. requirement: complete a natural science sequence as specified in the concentration: PHYS F211X General Physics I + PHYS F212X General Physics II, or PHYS F123X College Physics I + PHYS F124X College Physics II. Courses double-count toward the Mathematics concentration; counted once here, listed under the concentration.

courses.title: Remaining B.S. degree requirements (4 credits)
courses.choice_note: Remaining B.S. degree requirement credits (16 total per catalog).

courses.title: General Physics I
courses.choice_note: or PHYS F123X College Physics I; with PHYS F212X or F124X (8-credit sequence, shared with B.S. requirements)

courses.title: MATH electives at the 300 level or above (15 credits)
courses.choice_note: At least 15 credits of MATH electives at the 300 level or above; suggested packages include MATH F305 Geometry, MATH F320 Topics in Combinatorics or F321 Number Theory, F404 Introduction to Topology, F410 Introduction to Complex Analysis, plus 6 credits from MATH/STAT 300+ electives, CS F103 Introduction to Computer Programming or CS F201 Computer Science I, or other advisor-approved electives.

courses.title: General electives (28 credits)
courses.choice_note: Catalog range 23-29; recorded 28 to reconcile the published 120-credit minimum at catalog minimums elsewhere.
